evals.name: stagehand-v4-api-shape-not-playwright-wrapper
evals.prompt: 我们要用 Browserbase 的 Stagehand 框架在云端浏览器里打开一个电商页面，点击「加入购物车」按钮，然后用自然语言抽取购物车里显示的商品数量。请用 TypeScript 写这段代码，浏览器跑在 Browserbase 云端（不是本地）。
evals.expected_output: 从 `@browserbasehq/stagehand` 导入 `browserbase` 和 `Stagehand`，用 `await browserbase.launch({ apiKey: process.env.BROWSERBASE_API_KEY })` 拿到一个 `browser` 对象，再用 `await Stagehand.create({ browser })` 创建 Stagehand 实例；`act`/`extract` 是 `stagehand` 实例自己的方法（`stagehand.act(...)`、`stagehand.extract(...)`），不是挂在某个 Playwright `page` 对象上的方法；不使用 `new Stagehand({ env: "BROWSERBASE", apiKey, projectId })` 这种旧构造函数签名，也不通过 `stagehand.page.act(...)` 或导入 playwright-core 来驱动 Stagehand。
expectations: Imports `browserbase` and `Stagehand` from `@browserbasehq/stagehand` (not from `@browserbasehq/sdk` alone, and not treating Stagehand as a Playwright wrapper)
Obtains a browser via `browserbase.launch({ apiKey: ... })` (or equivalent Browserbase cloud factory), not `localBrowser.launch()`, since the task requires a cloud/Browserbase browser
Creates the Stagehand client via `Stagehand.create({ browser })`

Calls `stagehand.act(...)` and `stagehand.extract(...)` directly on the Stagehand instance — does NOT call `.act()`/`.extract()` on a `page` object, and does NOT use the old `new Stagehand({ env: "BROWSERBASE", apiKey, projectId })` v2/v3 constructor shape
Reads the Browserbase API key from an environment variable rather than hardcoding it

evals.name: forgotten-session-billing-cleanup
evals.prompt: 写一个 Node.js 脚本：用 Browserbase 创建一个浏览器会话，用 Playwright 连上去，截一张首页的图，然后把会话干净地收尾，不要留下持续计费的风险。给这个脚本加上基本的错误处理，确保就算截图那步抛异常，会话也不会被落下不管。
evals.expected_output: 脚本创建会话后用 `try/finally`（或等价的保证执行机制）包裹主要逻辑；`finally` 块里既关闭 Playwright 的 `browser` 连接，也调用 Browserbase API/SDK 显式请求释放该会话（例如 `bb.sessions.update(session.id, { status: "REQUEST_RELEASE" })`），而不是只调用 `browser.close()` 就假设会话已经完全结束、不再计费；代码或注释体现出对「未显式释放的会话会持续按分钟计费，尤其是 keepAlive 场景」这件事的认识。
expectations: Wraps session creation, connection, and the screenshot step in a try/finally (or equivalent) construct so cleanup runs even if the screenshot step throws

The cleanup path calls `browser.close()` (Playwright-side disconnect) AND separately calls the Browserbase Sessions API/SDK to request release (e.g. `sessions.update(session.id, { status: "REQUEST_RELEASE" })`), rather than assuming closing the Playwright browser object alone ends Browserbase-side billing
Does not set `keepAlive: true` without also including an explicit release call somewhere reachable in all code paths
Reads the API key from an environment variable, not hardcoded

evals.name: fully-autonomous-task-agents-not-stagehand-loop
evals.prompt: 我想要一个完全自动的功能：给一个自然语言描述的任务（比如「去 Hacker News 首页，返回排名前三的新闻标题和链接」），系统自己规划步骤、自己决定点哪里、自己判断什么时候算完成，返回一个结构化的 JSON 结果给我。我不想自己写任何「先做 A 再做 B」的控制流代码。请用 Browserbase 实现这个功能。
evals.expected_output: 使用 Browserbase Agents 产品（`POST /v1/agents/runs` 或对应 SDK 方法 `bb.agents.runs.create({ task, resultSchema })`），把整个自然语言任务和期望的结构化输出 schema 一次性交给 Browserbase，服务端自主完成规划、点击、判断完成条件的整个循环；调用方代码只负责创建 run 后轮询 `GET /v1/agents/runs/{runId}` 直到状态到达终态（COMPLETED/FAILED/STOPPED/TIMED_OUT），再读取结果，而不是自己写一个调用 Stagehand `act`/`extract`/`observe` 的循环来手动实现「规划-执行-判断」这几步（那样就是自己实现了控制流，违背了任务里「不想自己写任何控制流代码」的要求）。
expectations: Uses the Browserbase Agents API (POST /v1/agents/runs or the SDK's `agents.runs.create`), not a hand-rolled loop calling Stagehand `act`/`extract`/`observe` directly
Passes the natural-language task as `task` and the desired structured output as `resultSchema` (JSON Schema) rather than trying to parse free text after the fact
Polls the run by its `runId` until a terminal status (COMPLETED/FAILED/STOPPED/TIMED_OUT) rather than assuming the create call returns the final result synchronously
Does not write its own step-by-step control flow (e.g. explicit if/else deciding which element to click next) — that would defeat the stated requirement of not writing control-flow code
Reads the API key from an environment variable, not hardcoded

evals.name: clean-internal-tool-session-no-implicit-anti-detection
evals.prompt: 我们要给内部管理后台做一个自动化巡检脚本，跑在受信任的内网环境，访问的是我们自己公司的内部系统（不是公开网站，不会遇到真实验证码）。请用 Browserbase 创建一个「干净」的会话：不要做任何多余的反爬 / 验证码破解 / 代理处理，我们要的是最简单直接、行为可预测的浏览器连接，方便排查网络问题时不被额外的中间层干扰。
evals.expected_output: 创建会话时显式传入 `browserSettings: { solveCaptchas: false }`（因为 `solveCaptchas` 默认是开启的，不显式关闭的话，即使目标站点根本没有验证码，这个开关仍然默认为 true，属于「默认值和直觉不符」的一个点，需要显式声明而不是假设不传就是关闭状态），不需要额外传 `proxies`（默认就是 `false`，不需要显式设置也能达到「不用代理」的效果，但代码或说明应体现出对这两个开关默认值不对称的认识——一个默认开、一个默认关）。
expectations: Session creation explicitly sets `browserSettings.solveCaptchas: false`, rather than assuming a 'clean' session already has CAPTCHA solving off by default

Does not need to explicitly set `proxies: false` to satisfy the 'no proxy' requirement, since proxies already default to false, but the code or accompanying explanation does not incorrectly claim solveCaptchas also defaults to false
The explanation (in code comments or prose) correctly states that solveCaptchas defaults to true and proxies defaults to false — it does not treat both settings as having the same default
Does not enable `verified` or add proxy configuration, consistent with the 'no extra anti-detection layers' requirement

evals.name: login-persistence-across-days-context-not-keepalive
evals.prompt: 我们有一个每天早上跑一次的定时任务（cron job，每次都是全新的进程/脚本执行），需要用 Browserbase 打开一个需要登录的网站抓取报表数据。第一次运行时我们会手动登录一次，之后希望后续每天的定时任务都不需要重新登录，直接复用之前的登录态。请说明并写代码实现这个「登录态跨天、跨多次独立脚本运行持续保留」的需求。
evals.expected_output: 使用 Browserbase 的 Context 功能（`POST /v1/contexts` 创建一个 Context，拿到 `contextId`；之后每次创建会话时在 `browserSettings.context` 里传 `{ id: contextId, persist: true }`）来跨会话保留 cookies/登录态，而不是使用 `keepAlive`——keepAlive 解决的是「同一个会话断线后还能重连」，并不能让登录态跨越『每天全新进程创建全新会话』这种场景，两者是不同的机制；代码里应该有创建 Context（只做一次，通常是手动登录那一步）、以及后续每次定时任务创建会话时复用同一个 `contextId` 并设置 `persist: true` 这两部分。
expectations: Uses Browserbase Contexts (create a context, reuse its `contextId` across separate session creations) to persist login state, not `keepAlive`

Sets `persist: true` when reusing the context so that any state changes (e.g. token refresh during the scrape) are saved back, or explicitly explains persist:false is fine only for a strictly read-only reuse case

Does not claim `keepAlive: true` alone solves cross-day, cross-process login persistence — keepAlive only survives disconnects of the SAME session/process, not brand-new sessions created by a fresh cron invocation
The one-time manual login step is done inside a session created with the same `contextId` and `persist: true`, so the login actually gets saved into the context
Reads the API key from an environment variable, not hardcoded
